# VidFlow — Free Universal Video Downloader

## What is VidFlow?

VidFlow is a free online video downloader that supports YouTube, Bilibili, Douyin, TikTok, Twitter, Instagram and 1,000+ websites. No registration required. Paste a video link and download in original quality (4K, 1080p60, HDR). Also features AI video summarization, mind map generation, and subtitle extraction.

VidFlow is a web application with a FastAPI (Python) backend and Vue 3 frontend. It uses yt-dlp for video processing on most platforms, with custom direct API calls for Bilibili to avoid blocking issues.

## Key Features

### 1. Multi-Platform Support (1,000+ sites)
- **YouTube**: All qualities, including 4K HDR, 1080p60. Supports both server-side and direct link download modes.
- **Bilibili / B站**: No login required. Downloads from 360P to 4K using Bilibili's public API. Includes multi-part (分P) video support.
- **Douyin / TikTok**: Video download supported. Audio requires cookies configuration.
- **Twitter / X**: Full video download support.
- **Instagram**: Reel and post video download.
- **And 1,000+ more** via yt-dlp engine (Vimeo, Facebook, Dailymotion, etc.)

### 2. Original Quality Downloads
- **4K, 1080p60, HDR**: Download at the highest available resolution.
- **Format selection**: Choose specific resolution and format (MP4, WebM, MKV).
- **Audio-only mode**: Extract MP3 audio from any video.
- **Server-side download**: Stable download with real-time WebSocket progress tracking (0.5s intervals).
- **Direct link mode**: Fast download via proxy — extracts direct CDN URL, streams through server with Content-Disposition header.
- **Automatic format merging**: FFmpeg auto-detection — merges best video + best audio when available.

### 3. AI Video Summarization
- **Automatic subtitle extraction**:
  - Bilibili: Uses public API (`x/v2/dm/view`) — no login required. Prefers human-generated subtitles, falls back to AI-generated.
  - YouTube / others: Uses yt-dlp to extract auto-generated captions (VTT format).
- **AI Summary & Key Points**: Sends subtitle text to DeepSeek API (deepseek-chat model) for structured output — one-sentence summary + bullet-point key takeaways.
- **Interactive Mind Map**: Rendered with markmap (markdown-to-mindmap), with fullscreen mode and PNG download.
- **AI Q&A Chat**: Ask questions about the video content. Chat history retained (last 10 rounds).
- **Subtitle Download**: Export subtitles as SRT files (Bilibili JSON and VTT auto-converted to SRT).

### 4. Zero Friction
- **No registration**: No accounts, no sign-up required.
- **No ads**: Clean interface, no advertisements.
- **No waiting queues**: Instant download, no queue system.
- **Works on mobile**: Fully responsive design, adapts to all screen sizes.
- **Bilingual**: Chinese and English interface toggle, language preference persisted in localStorage.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How to download YouTube videos?
1. Copy the YouTube video URL from your browser address bar.
2. Open VidFlow (https://vidflow.cn) and paste the URL into the input box.
3. Click "Parse" — VidFlow will load the video title, thumbnail, duration, and available formats.
4. Select your preferred quality from the format chips (e.g., 1080p, 4K, audio-only).
5. Choose download mode: "Server" (reliable, supports format conversion) or "Direct" (fast, no server-side storage).
6. Click "Download" and watch the real-time progress bar.
7. Once complete, click "Save file" to save the video to your device.

### How to download Bilibili (B站) videos?
1. Copy the Bilibili video URL (e.g., https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xx411c7mD).
2. Paste into VidFlow and click "Parse" — no login or cookies required.
3. VidFlow uses Bilibili's public API (`x/web-interface/view` + `x/player/playurl`) for reliable extraction.
4. Select quality from 360P to 4K (single-file MP4 with audio, no separate merging needed).
5. Click "Download" — the video streams directly from Bilibili's CDN through VidFlow's proxy.

### Is VidFlow really free?
Yes, VidFlow is completely free. There is no registration, no hidden fees, no premium tiers, and no download limits. The AI video summarization feature requires the server administrator to configure a DeepSeek API key, but remains free for end users.

### What platforms does VidFlow support?
VidFlow supports 1,000+ websites including:
- YouTube (youtube.com, youtu.be)
- Bilibili / B站 (bilibili.com)
- Douyin / 抖音 (douyin.com)
- TikTok (tiktok.com)
- Twitter / X (twitter.com, x.com)
- Instagram (instagram.com)
- Facebook (facebook.com)
- Vimeo (vimeo.com)
- Dailymotion (dailymotion.com)
- And many more via yt-dlp's extensive extractor list.

### Can I use VidFlow on mobile?
Yes, VidFlow is fully responsive. The interface adapts to mobile screen sizes with stacked layouts, full-width thumbnails, and touch-friendly buttons. It works on iOS Safari, Android Chrome, and other mobile browsers.

### How does AI video summarization work?
1. VidFlow extracts subtitles from the video:
   - Bilibili: Queries the public subtitle API (`x/v2/dm/view`) using the video's aid and cid.
   - Other platforms: Uses yt-dlp to download auto-generated captions (VTT format).
2. The subtitle text is cleaned, timestamp-stripped, and truncated to 15,000 characters.
3. The text is sent to DeepSeek's API (deepseek-chat model, temperature=0.7) with a structured prompt requesting JSON output.
4. The response contains: a one-sentence summary, a list of key points, and an outline in markdown format.
5. The frontend renders: summary text, key points list, interactive mind map (via markmap), and a chat interface for follow-up questions.

### What video quality can I download?
VidFlow downloads at the highest quality available on the source platform:
- YouTube: Up to 4K (2160p), 1080p60 HDR, depending on what the uploader provided.
- Bilibili: Up to 4K, depending on the uploader's source quality. VidFlow supports all Bilibili quality tiers (360P, 480P, 720P, 1080P, 1080P+, 4K).
- Other platforms: Maximum quality available through yt-dlp extraction.

### Do I need to install anything?
No. VidFlow is a web application — you use it entirely in your browser. The server handles all video processing. No browser extensions, no desktop software, no command-line tools needed.

### Why does Bilibili work without login?
VidFlow uses Bilibili's public (unauthenticated) web APIs:
- `api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/view` — Video metadata (title, cover, duration, cid, multi-part list)
- `api.bilibili.com/x/player/playurl` — Format list and CDN direct URLs (with `fnval=1` for single-file MP4)
- `api.bilibili.com/x/v2/dm/view` — Subtitle list (publicly accessible)

These are the same APIs the Bilibili website uses for anonymous visitors. yt-dlp's built-in Bilibili extractor was bypassed because it triggers 403 errors on player API requests.

### Is downloading videos legal?
VidFlow is intended for personal, educational use. Users should comply with applicable laws and respect intellectual property rights. The footer states: "请遵守相关法律法规 · 充分尊重知识产权" (Comply with laws and regulations · Respect intellectual property).

## Technical Information

### Architecture
- **Backend**: FastAPI (Python) — REST API + WebSocket for real-time progress
- **Frontend**: Vue 3 (Composition API) + Vite — Single File Component (App.vue), markmap for mind maps
- **Video engine**: yt-dlp (Python API) for most platforms; custom requests-based implementation for Bilibili
- **AI**: DeepSeek API (deepseek-chat) via OpenAI-compatible SDK
- **Storage**: Local `downloads/` directory — no database, tasks held in memory

### Download Modes
1. **Server mode (default)**: yt-dlp downloads video to server, WebSocket pushes progress every 0.5s. Supports FFmpeg merging (best video + best audio). File served via `/api/file/{task_id}`.
2. **Direct mode**: Backend extracts a direct CDN URL. Frontend loads via hidden iframe → proxy endpoint (`/api/proxy-download`) → server streams content with `Content-Disposition: attachment`. Falls back to server mode if direct URL is unavailable.

### API Endpoints
- `POST /api/info` — Parse video URL, return metadata and format list
- `POST /api/download` — Start download (server or direct mode)
- `GET /api/file/{task_id}` — Serve downloaded file
- `GET /api/task/{task_id}` — Poll task status
- `GET /api/thumbnail?url=...` — Proxy thumbnail images (bypass CORS/Referrer)
- `GET /api/proxy-download?url=...&filename=...` — Stream proxy for direct downloads
- `POST /api/subtitles` — Extract video subtitles
- `GET /api/subtitles/download?url=...` — Download subtitles as SRT
- `POST /api/summarize` — AI video summarization
- `POST /api/chat` — AI Q&A about video content
- `GET /api/cookies-status` — Check cookies.txt configuration
- `WS /ws/progress/{task_id}` — Real-time download progress

### Privacy & Data Handling
- **No user accounts**: No registration, no login, no user data stored.
- **Temporary files**: Downloaded videos stored in local `downloads/` directory. Users retrieve files via download links.
- **In-memory tasks**: Download task status stored in Python dict — lost on server restart. No persistent task history.
- **No tracking**: No analytics, no cookies (except optional `cookies.txt` for platform authentication).
- **Subtitle caching**: Extracted subtitles cached in memory per URL — cleared on server restart.

### Limitations
- **Bilibili API dependency**: Relies on Bilibili's public web APIs — may break if APIs change.
- **Douyin audio**: Requires `cookies.txt` for audio track download (video-only works without).
- **YouTube SSL**: May fail in some network environments (e.g., restricted regions).
- **No batch downloads**: Single video download only — no queue or playlist support.
- **Ephemeral tasks**: Task status lost on server restart (no persistence layer).
- **FFmpeg optional**: Without FFmpeg, falls back to single-stream download (no audio-video merging).

### Browser Support
- Chrome (latest)
- Firefox (latest)
- Safari (latest)
- Edge (latest)
- Mobile browsers (iOS Safari, Android Chrome)

## Getting Started (for Developers)

### Prerequisites
- Python 3.9+
- Node.js 18+
- FFmpeg (optional, for audio-video merging)
- DeepSeek API key (optional, for AI features)

### Development Setup
```bash
# Backend
cd backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
uvicorn main:app --port 8000 --reload

# Frontend
cd frontend
npm install
npx vite
# Opens at http://localhost:5173
```

### Production Deployment
```bash
cd frontend && npx vite build
cd backend && uvicorn main:app --port 8000
# Site available at http://localhost:8000
```

### Configuration
- `cookies.txt`: Netscape-format cookies file at project root for platform authentication (optional).
- `.env`: `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=your-key` at project root for AI features (optional).
